The project builds successfully. Here's what was created:

**Project:** `RecipeCommunity` — Blazor Web App (.NET 9, Server interactivity)

**Structure:**
- `Models/Recipe.cs` — Recipe model with title, category, ingredients, steps, ratings

- **Pages (static SSR):**
  - `Home.razor` — Category grid with icons and recipe counts
  - `Category.razor` — Lists recipes in a category with star previews
  - `RecipeDetail.razor` — Full recipe with ingredients/steps
- **Interactive components** (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`):
  - `StarRating.razor` — Click-to-rate 1–5 stars widget (on recipe detail page)
  - `SubmitRecipe.razor` — Form with title, category, ingredients, steps

**Design choices:**
- Most pages use static SSR (read-only content) — only the star rating widget and submit form use `InteractiveServer`
- Green color scheme (`#2d6a4f`) with scoped CSS per component
- Navigation bar with Home and Submit Recipe links

Run with `dotnet run --project RecipeCommunity`.
